---
title: "Florida Elections"
---

This page examines results from the 2026 Florida primary election using precinct-level data from the Florida Department of State Division of Elections.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

# Read the Florida 2026 Senate results
results <- read_csv("florida_senate_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Plot total votes for the US Senate race
results |>
  group_by(candidate, party) |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(candidate, total_votes), y = total_votes, fill = party)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DEM" = "#2E74C0", "REP" = "#CB454A")) +
  labs(
    title = "Florida 2026 US Senate Primary",
    subtitle = "Total votes cast by candidate and party",
    x = "Candidate",
    y = "Total Votes",
    fill = "Party"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

The chart above displays the total statewide votes cast in the 2026 Florida U.S. Senate primary election by candidate and political party.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Find winning candidate/party in each county
county_winners <- results |>
  group_by(county, candidate, party) |>
  summarize(votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") |>
  slice_max(votes, by = county) |>
  mutate(
    subregion = tolower(county) |>
      str_replace_all("\\.", "") |>
      str_replace("^desoto$", "de soto")
  )

# Join with Florida county boundaries
fl_map <- map_data("county") |>
  filter(region == "florida") |>
  left_join(county_winners, by = "subregion")

# Plot the county results map
ggplot(fl_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = party)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DEM" = "#2E74C0", "REP" = "#CB454A")) +
  labs(
    title = "Florida 2026 US Senate Primary Results by County",
    subtitle = "Top vote-getting party in each county",
    fill = "Party"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
